text: Tell me what man goes months and years without sex until they find the right person. Every man! Stop the lies! 95% plus of men on this planet have that exact experience. I'm just telling you the truth. Most men on the planet Earth don't have access to pu**y. What about brothels? They have no money! They've got no fu**ing money! They're living with brothel! Look, the guy is exaggerating with 95%, but he's actually pointing at something real. A huge number of young men today are going months, even years, without any intimacy. And this isn't some internet myth. We have data. According to the U.S. General Social Survey, for men aged 18 to 24, the percentage who had zero sex in the past year jumped from about 19% in 2000 to around 31% by 2018. For women in the same age group, the number went from roughly 15% to 19%. And remember self-report bias. Men tend to over-report. Women tend to under-report. So the real figure for men could easily be higher than 31%. And that's annual data. If we looked at 6 months, 3 months, or 1 month, the percentage of sexless men most likely be much higher. The reality is simple. Most men don't have regular access to intimacy. Meanwhile, many women online act surprised. Men go years without sex? Yes. Most men aren't rotating options or drowning in attention. A small percentage of guys get the majority of interest. And the rest are nearly invisible. So when men say dating is hard today, believe them. They are not playing victim. They are describing reality. But here's the key. This shouldn't make you hopeless. It should make you focused. The dating landscape has shifted, which means you need to level up, not give up. Improve your habits, your body, your mindset, your confidence, your social skills. You are not broken. You are not alone. A lot of good men are fighting the same battle. Stay consistent. Keep improving. And you will win in this environment. The challenge is real, but so is your ability to rise above it.
